title: Directionally Weighted Total Variation for Inverse Problems
summary: We study weighted total variation (TV) regularization for inverse problems in which the forward operator has a large null space, a setting in which standard (unweighted) TV is known to produce systematic reconstruction artifacts such as spatial bias. To address this issue, we consider spatially varying weights derived from a sensitivity analysis of the forward operator expression via an associated Green's function.
